note: Float-trip campground on the Gasconade River near Dixon, 14 miles from Fort Leonard Wood's main gate; RV sites line the campground road along the river bank, with tent sites, cabins, a pond and canoe/raft/kayak/tube rentals. --Claude
summary: Operator pages (2026): $46 W/E 50A riverside / $50 full hookup for up to 5, open May 1-Oct 15 (closes in high water), Newbook booking, 10% active-duty military; Google 4.5 (259). No phone stored: 573-759-7294. Pin is the office ~460 m from the sites. Waterfront lead riverfront -> riverview (the campground road runs between the pads and the bank).
